title: Command Execution Workflow
description: BaseCommand lifecycle: initialize phase → Composer instance resolution → PreCommandRunEvent dispatch → subcommand execute() → Installer configuration → run()
activity_flow: BaseCommand::initialize(InputInterface, OutputInterface) called by Symfony Console
IF command is SelfUpdateCommand → force both flags true
IF composer resolved → dispatch PreCommandRunEvent via EventDispatcher
Apply env var overrides for options (COMPOSER_NO_DEV, COMPOSER_PREFER_STABLE, etc.)
Apply COMPOSER_IGNORE_PLATFORM_REQS env var if applicable
Call parent::initialize() to complete Symfony Console initialization
Call requireComposer() to get validated Composer instance
IF --no-blocking OR --no-security-blocking OR env COMPOSER_NO_BLOCKING → policyConfig->withBlockingDisabled()
Configure Installer: setPreferSource, setPreferDist, setOptimizeAutoloader, setClassMapAuthoritative, setPolicyConfig, setAuditConfig, etc.
END: Return integer exit code to Symfony Console

key_methods.BaseCommand::initialize: Reads flags, resolves Composer, dispatches PreCommandRunEvent, applies env overrides
key_methods.BaseCommand::requireComposer: Returns cached $this->composer or calls Application::getComposer(true, ...); throws on failure
key_methods.BaseCommand::tryComposer: Returns cached $this->composer or calls Application::getComposer(false, ...); returns null on failure
key_methods.BaseCommand::getPreferredInstallOptions: Returns [preferSource, preferDist] from config + CLI flags; validates --prefer-install conflicts
key_methods.BaseCommand::createPolicyConfig: PolicyConfig::fromConfig($config) + optional withBlockingDisabled() based on flags/env

key_relationships: InstallCommand extends BaseCommand, calls createPolicyConfig + getPreferredInstallOptions + Installer::create
Script\Event extends BaseEvent, holds Composer + IOInterface + devMode
Installer configured by execute() with preferSource, preferDist, policyConfig, auditConfig
conditions_and_branches: SelfUpdateCommand → always disable plugins and scripts
tryComposer returns null → fallback to Factory::createGlobal
composer resolved → dispatch PreCommandRunEvent (skipped if no composer)
important_notes: BaseCommand is abstract; concrete subcommands implement execute(). The initialize() phase is Symfony Console lifecycle, called before execute(). Script\Event (name, Composer, IO, devMode, args, flags) is dispatched by EventDispatcher for script hooks, not directly in BaseCommand. PolicyConfig introduced in Composer 2.x for blocking-policy control.
